title: When the Autopsy Turns
author: Ivo Vasquez
blurb: Beatrix Okonkwo, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has spent twenty years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
